guard.purpose: Training time and memory limits only; no image generation

protocol.retention_limit: Only five declared gradient/prediction updates are retained; omitted training gradients/velocities cannot be independently replayed.

projection.limitation: Measured two-step extrapolation with 20% time margin and120s I/O/checkpoint allowance; actual deadline and memory guards still apply.

precision.outer_autocast: Native CUDA BF16 with default cache setting
